descriptions: You reach the threshold of {LOCATION}. The {ANTAGONIST} is close — you can feel it.
On the ground near the exit: a {MACGUFFIN}. Do you take it, or keep moving?

commands.look: The exit is north. A {MACGUFFIN} lies at your feet. The {ANTAGONIST} is getting closer.
commands.take {MACGUFFIN}: You snatch the {MACGUFFIN} and press north. Good call.

latents.fact: a {ADJ} cracked lens from some kind of optical device is wedged in a crack in the east wall
latents.item_desc: A {ADJ} lens, cracked diagonally. When you hold it up, shapes look wrong through it.

latents.fact: there is a second door behind the {ADJ} tapestry on the east wall — it is unlocked
latents.exit_desc: A narrow passage behind the tapestry, leading somewhere quieter.

latents.fact: the floor here is slightly warmer than the rest of the room — something runs beneath it
